question: I was charged twice for my Pro subscription this month. Can you help?
response: I'm sorry about the double charge — that's frustrating, and we'll get it sorted. I can see two ways this usually happens: a retried payment after a card timeout, or an accidental second subscription on another workspace. Could you tell me the last 4 digits of the card and whether you have more than one workspace? Once I can confirm which case it is, I'll refund the duplicate immediately — refunds take 3–5 business days to appear on your statement. If you'd rather not wait for my checks, I can also open a billing ticket right now so the finance team follows up within one business day.

question: How do I export my project data before closing my account?
response: You can export everything yourself in about two minutes: Settings → Workspace → Export, choose 'Full export (JSON + attachments)', and you'll receive a download link by email when the archive is ready — usually under 10 minutes for typical projects. The export includes projects, tasks, comments and uploaded files; it does not include audit logs, which only workspace owners can request separately. One honest caveat: if you close the account before the export email arrives, the link stops working, so please wait for the download to finish before deleting anything. Would you like me to trigger the export for you now?

question: Your app deleted three hours of my work. I'm furious.
response: I completely understand being furious — losing three hours of work is awful, and I'm not going to brush that aside. Before anything else, let's see what's recoverable: the editor autosaves a version snapshot every 2 minutes, kept for 30 days, under File → Version history. In most 'lost work' cases the content is there under a session labelled with yesterday's timestamp. If the version history is empty, that points to the sync bug we're currently tracking, and I'll escalate your case with your session logs attached so engineering can attempt a server-side recovery — they've succeeded in roughly half of these cases, and I won't promise more than that. Can you check Version history now and tell me what you see?

question: Does the free plan include API access?
response: Partially. The free plan includes read-only API access at 100 requests per hour — enough to pull your data into scripts or dashboards. Write access (creating and updating items via API) starts with the Starter plan. Two things people often miss: webhooks are available on all plans including free, and the rate limit is per workspace, not per user, so a busy shared workspace can hit the ceiling faster than expected. If you tell me what you're trying to build, I can say concretely whether the free tier will be enough for it.

question: The mobile app keeps logging me out every day. Is that normal?
response: Daily logouts are not normal — sessions on mobile should last 30 days. The usual culprits, in order of likelihood: a password manager clearing app storage, the OS battery optimizer killing background refresh (which invalidates the token on some Android versions), or your workspace having a security policy that forces daily re-authentication. Could you tell me your platform (iOS/Android) and whether you're on a company workspace? If it's the security policy, that's working as your admin configured it and I can tell you who to talk to; if it's the Android token issue, there's a fix in version 4.2.1 — checking your app version would settle it quickly.

question: Following up — I'm on Android, personal workspace, app version 4.1.8.

history.content: The mobile app keeps logging me out every day. Is that normal?
Daily logouts are not normal. Could you tell me your platform and whether you're on a company workspace? If it's the Android token issue, there's a fix in version 4.2.1.

response: That narrows it down nicely: 4.1.8 on Android is exactly the range affected by the token-refresh bug, and your personal workspace rules out a security policy. Updating to 4.2.1 or later from the Play Store should stop the daily logouts — the fix landed in 4.2.1's release notes as 'session token renewal on backgrounded devices'. After updating, you'll be logged out one final time (the old token can't be migrated), and then the session should hold for the normal 30 days. If it recurs even once after the update, come back with the timestamp and I'll pull the session logs, because then it's something we haven't seen.

question: Can I pay yearly by invoice instead of credit card?
response: Yes — yearly invoicing is available on Business and Enterprise plans for amounts over $1,000/year, paid by bank transfer with net-30 terms. It's not available on Starter or Pro, where card payment keeps costs down; I'd rather tell you that plainly than route you through a sales call to hear the same thing. If your team is on Pro and wants invoicing, the practical path is upgrading to Business, which at your team size may cost less than you expect with the yearly discount — I can run the numbers for your exact seat count if you tell me how many people need access.
